title: 雷射尖峰退火
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解光斑掃描、局部熱峰、圖案吸收，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 雷射熱歷程
stages.description: 在「雷射熱歷程」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for laser thermal history, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 毫秒與奈秒
steps.objective: 完成「毫秒與奈秒」的因果圖，把光斑掃描、局部熱峰、圖案吸收中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes, connecting relevant limits in beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：毫秒與奈秒。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：不同脈衝時間不能視為同一熱處理。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不同脈衝時間不能視為同一熱處理。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「毫秒與奈秒」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「毫秒與奈秒」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 毫秒與奈秒的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes principle
knowledge.text: 不同脈衝時間不能視為同一熱處理。
knowledge.textEn: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 熱擴散尺度約與時間平方根成正比；縮短熱脈衝可減少深部受熱，但表面溫度仍需量測。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal diffusion length scales roughly with square-root time; shorter pulses reduce deep heating but still require surface thermometry.

quiz.question: 評估「毫秒與奈秒」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes?
options: 不同脈衝時間不能視為同一熱處理。
峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。
化學摻雜濃度就是活化載子濃度。
optionsEn: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process.
Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets.
Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.
quiz.explanation: 不同脈衝時間不能視為同一熱處理。 熱擴散尺度約與時間平方根成正比；縮短熱脈衝可減少深部受熱，但表面溫度仍需量測。
quiz.explanationEn: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process. Thermal diffusion length scales roughly with square-root time; shorter pulses reduce deep heating but still require surface thermometry.

Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Optical absorption and thermal diffusion jointly set heated depth. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assess optical penetration: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：峰值與積分能量。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：相同能量可能有不同峰值溫度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate peak and integrated energy. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Equal energy can produce different peak temperatures. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「相同能量可能有不同峰值溫度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for separate peak and integrated energy: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Melting changes recrystallization and dopant redistribution mechanisms. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
